decisions.label: Fade out
decisions.note: How long the loading screen takes to fade out onto her bedroom once its supernova has whited it out, seconds (loading.fadeOut; 2.5 as built, Ed, 2026-11-03: "can we fade from the loading screen to the bedroom over a few seconds"; it was a 1.2 s white clearing). Her wake-up starts as it begins. At most 0.6 with reduced motion. Remembered on this browser; takes effect on the next load (the screen is over before the game can pause).
